rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: At the first sitting of the Sixth Parliament, with the Chief Justice presiding under section 86(2), Matamela Cyril Ramaphosa was nominated and, 'There being no further nominations', the Chief Justice declared him duly elected President of the Republic of South Africa.
